_about: Operator-seeded demo dataset — real-shaped podcast narration scripts used by bench.py to make the resilience numbers deterministic on a fresh clone. This is realistic background material, NOT the capability being judged: the capability is CastIron's self-healing render/verify/publish engine, which the benchmark exercises over these scripts. Labeled per the honesty rules in DEMO.md.
hero_query: Kill the primary TTS provider mid-render — does the episode still ship, hash-verified and published?

episodes.script: Tonight on the space update — and this is where naive TTS trips — the rover crossed the ridge, paused — for a long dramatic beat — then rolled on.
episodes.note: em-dash pacing trap: doubles as the AgentLoop gate's iterate case, and is the hero failover script.

episodes.script: Markets closed higher today, with the broad index up nearly one percent as chipmakers led the rally and energy lagged. We break down what the move means for next week.
episodes.note: clean daily-brief script, no pacing traps.

episodes.script: It was raining the night the last call came in. Nobody picked up. By morning, the only witness had already left town — and taken the answer with them.
episodes.note: narrative cold-open; longer prosody, tests the mix stage.

episodes.script: Good morning. Three things today: the release is on track, the migration finished overnight, and we are one review away from shipping the new dashboard.
On this day in nineteen sixty-nine, three astronauts began a journey that would end with a single small step — and a sentence the whole world would memorize.
What if your podcast never went down? Not when a provider throttles you, not when an API returns a five hundred. That is the show we are building — and this is episode one.
